name: Gryth Thurden
summary: In Ironforge, Gryth Thurden can send you back toward Loch Modan with a parcel. You carry the Honorary Picks from Golnir Bouldertoe for Brock Stoneseeker's mining apprentices, and the city's gryphon roost offers a way over the mountain roads.

sections.title: A Courier for the Miners
sections.body: You have traveled from Loch Modan to the Great Forge, where Golnir Bouldertoe gives you Honorary Picks for Brock Stoneseeker's mining apprentices. He points you to Ironforge's gryphon network instead of the mountain passes on foot. Carry the bundle across the city to the master handler, who can arrange your flight back.

sections.title: Taking Wing to Thelsamar
sections.body: Gryth Thurden oversees Ironforge's flight roosts in the great mountain hall. Gryphon routes link the city with dwarven settlements across Khaz Modan. After scouting the route and speaking with the local handler, you can ask Gryth to arrange transport back to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar. The picks are bound for Brock Stoneseeker's apprentices, and the route joins mountain settlements by air.

faq.q: What are the Honorary Picks for?
faq.answer: Golnir Bouldertoe crafted the Honorary Picks in Ironforge as ceremonial tools for the students of Brock Stoneseeker, a mining instructor stationed in Thelsamar.
Gryth Thurden oversees Ironforge's flight routes from the dwarven capital to settlements across Khaz Modan and beyond.

faq.q: Where is Gryth Thurden located in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Gryth Thurden is at the Great Forge's flight roost, near Ironforge's main central thoroughfare and gates.

faq.q: Why do I need to talk to Thorgrum Borrelson first?
faq.answer: Gryth Thurden can send a rider to Thelsamar only after you have spoken with Thorgrum Borrelson, the handler stationed in Loch Modan. Handlers dispatch riders along charted routes.

faq.q: What happens after giving the picks to Gryth Thurden?
faq.answer: After inspecting the parcel, Gryth prepares a gryphon flight so you can return to Thelsamar and deliver the tools directly to Brock Stoneseeker.

faq.q: Who sends you to Gryth Thurden?
faq.answer: Golnir Bouldertoe, an artisan working around Ironforge's Great Forge, gives you the picks and directs you to Gryth.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you rely on gryphons to cross treacherous peaks. They are a practical necessity and a point of ancestral pride linking the mountain halls.
As a miner, you help Brock Stoneseeker's apprentices in Loch Modan with ceremonial picks forged in Ironforge to honor their craft.
As an Alliance member, you can rely on Ironforge's gryphon roosts to carry envoys between Dun Morogh, Loch Modan, and the broader kingdoms.
